title: Blueth Alerts
description: Free Discord webhook alerts for your Minecraft server — zero config, instant setup.
body:
# 🔔 Blueth Alerts

**Know what's happening on your server — without logging in.**

Blueth Alerts sends beautiful Discord webhook notifications for the events that matter. Drop the JAR, paste your webhook URL, restart. That's it.

---

## ✨ Features

| Event | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| 🟢 **Player Join/Leave** | Player name, UUID, online count |
| 💀 **Player Death** | Death message, location, killer (PVP) |
| 💬 **Chat Logging** | Opt-in only, off by default for privacy |
| 🚀 **Server Start/Stop** | Version info, uptime on shutdown |
| ⚡ **Low TPS Warning** | Configurable threshold with spam cooldown |
| 🏆 **Advancements** | Player achievement notifications |
| 🔧 **Staff Commands** | Permission-based command logging |
| 🌟 **First Join** | Special welcome notification for new players |

## ⚡ Quick Start

1. Drop `BluethAlerts.jar` into your `plugins/` folder
2. Set your Discord webhook URL in `plugins/BluethAlerts/config.yml`
3. Restart. Done. ✅

## 🛡️ Built Right

- **Fully async** — zero main thread impact
- **Rate limited** — built-in 5/5s limiter, never hits Discord rate limits
- **Privacy first** — chat logging off by default
- **Lightweight** — 29KB JAR, no dependencies required

## 🔧 Commands

| Command | Permission | Description |
|---------|-----------|-------------|
| `/alerts reload` | `blueth.alerts.admin` | Reload config |
| `/alerts test` | `blueth.alerts.admin` | Send test webhook |
| `/alerts status` | `blueth.alerts.admin` | Show enabled events |

## ❓ FAQ

**Will this lag my server?** No — all webhook calls are fully async with built-in rate limiting.

**Does it work with Geyser/Bedrock?** Yes — player events fire normally for Bedrock players.

**Folia support?** Planned for a future update.

**Privacy concerns with chat logging?** Chat logging is OFF by default. You must explicitly enable it.
